definitions.explanation: To engage in employment or productive activity. The most common verb for working at a job.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}で{働|はたら}いています。
{毎日|まいにち}8{時間|じかん}{働|はたら}きます。
{父|ちち}は{銀行|ぎんこう}で{働|はたら}いています。
examples.english: My father works at a bank.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xで{働|はたら}く (work at X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {働|はたら}いている = 'is working' or 'works (habitually).'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{会社|かいしゃ}で{働|はたら}く (work at a company)
・8{時間|じかん}{働|はたら}く (work 8 hours)
・{働|はたら}いている (is working/employed)
・{働|はたら}き{方|かた} (way of working)

Uses で for workplace. Different from {勤|つと}める (employed at - focuses on organization).

Related: {仕事|しごと} (work/job).
